messages.author: b285c60baa6a691e
messages.subject: Association Rule Mining and Shiny
parts:
Hi,
 
I am totally new to Shiny. I want to use it for association rule mining. I couln't find any example of Shiny regarding association rule mining. I created a small data set and I ran association rule mining on it. I only want to show all the generated rules on the browser but I have problem to do that.
I have attached dataset txt file. And here is the code to generate the rules:
 
After importing the dataset in R you should do:
 
library(arules)
#changing data  type to factor
for(i in 1:10){
dataset[,i]<-factor(dataset[,i])
}
#generating rules
rules<-apriori(dataset,parameter=list(support=0.20,confidence=0.20,minlen=2))
#displaying rules
inspect(sort(rules))
 
So now I want to somehow show all these 111 rules in the browser using shiny package.  I would really appreciate if you could help me.
